name: canvas-groups
prompt:
Phone players at low graphics quality say the block catalog flickers and some cards draw blank while it's open; on PC it looks fine. I counted 41 CanvasGroups in PlayerGui while the catalog is open: one for the panel and one per card, and almost all of them are just sitting there. The catalog is BlockCatalog.luau, opened with C or the Catalog button; Main.client.luau mounts it (both in src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts).

Fix it without changing how the catalog looks: the panel still fades in and out, and hovering a card still sweeps the shine across it, clipped to the card's rounded corners. Then write a short note in docs/perf/block-catalog.md: what you changed, and how I can check it.

checks.text: Cards are no longer built as CanvasGroups

rubric: With the catalog open and nothing hovered, only a handful of CanvasGroups exist (for example the panel's own), not one per card.

The shine is still clipped to the card's rounded corners: it is drawn inside a small CanvasGroup with a `UICorner` that exists only while that card's shine is showing (built for example with Vide's `show` on the hover or shine state) and is removed once the shine has gone.

The temporary shine group never pops: it is created while the shine is fully faded and removed only after it has faded out, for example by driving the group's own `GroupTransparency` from the shine strength, so hovering looks as smooth as before.
The card's content (swatch, name, shape, hit area) lives in plain Frames and labels and is never moved into and out of a temporary CanvasGroup.
The look is otherwise unchanged: the panel fades in and out, cards keep their layout and rounded corners, clicking a card still selects its block type and closes the catalog.

docs/perf/block-catalog.md says what changed and how to confirm it: CanvasGroup counts with the catalog closed, open and idle, and while hovering, before and after, plus what to check at low graphics quality on a phone.
Correct and in scope: the code is typed and readable, and luau-lsp, selene, and StyLua pass on the changed files. Extra supporting files, such as a preview story, count neither for nor against.
judge_facts: Vide 0.4.1 `show(condition, component)` (vide/src/show.luau, switch.luau) builds the component in a new scope when the condition turns truthy and destroys it (after the delay the builder returned) when it turns falsy. The builder's second argument, `present`, starts false, is set true right after the builder runs, and is set false when the condition goes away.
Vide 0.4.1 `spring(source, period?, dampingRatio?)` (vide/src/spring.luau) starts at the source's value when created and animates toward later values.
Vide 0.4.1 (vide/src/graph.luau): a `derive` reruns its readers only when its new value `~=` the old one.
